channel.title: MTUS+ notices
channel.description: Releases, known issues and corrections for Multinational Time Use Study Plus.

item.title: Release: Public Source Inventory published
item.description: The MTUS+ Source Inventory lists the 124 original surveys harmonised in MTUS and MTUS+ — 17 new in MTUS+ and 107 carried over from MTUS — with their producers, distributors, identifiers, access conditions and where to find the original data and documentation. Browse it on the Surveys page or download it as an Excel workbook.

item.title: Known issue: Belgium 1999 and 2005: clock times under review
item.description: In the legacy episode files, episode clock times for these two surveys appear shifted: far fewer people are asleep in the early hours than in every other survey. Both are left out of the day charts on this site until the times have been checked.

item.title: Known issue: Legacy surveys use interim activity codes
item.description: For surveys carried over from earlier MTUS releases, ICATUS and HETUS codes are derived from the CTUR 69-activity scheme through crosswalks, not from the original national codes. Detailed ICATUS categories for work and own-use production often cannot be recovered. These surveys will be re-harmonised from their original microdata over future releases.

item.title: Notice: MTUS+ website preview
item.description: This site previews MTUS+ Version 1, which is in preparation. Details marked “To be confirmed” will be finalised before the release.
